info.title: MarketLink API
info.description: The contract behind the MarketLink farmers-market app. Every route sits under `/api` and every failure carries the same envelope: `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`. Clients branch on `code`, never on `message`. Money is integer kobo end to end and formatted to ₦ only at the edge. There is no payment endpoint — orders settle in person at pickup.

post.summary: Create or refresh the profile behind a signed-up account
post.description: Supabase Auth knows the credentials; this database knows the person. Called once after sign-up, and safe to repeat. A farmer also gets a stall in `pending`, which is what puts them in the admin queue rather than straight onto the public catalogue. `role` accepts only customer and farmer — an admin is promoted in the database, never requested here.

200.description: The caller profile as now stored.

400.description: A field is missing, too long, or the role is not self-requestable.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, expired, or invalid.

get.summary: The caller profile, plus the stall they own if any
get.description: The single source of truth for who the client is rendering a dashboard for: the role and `farmer.status` here decide which screens appear, and a farmer in `pending` sees an awaiting-approval notice instead of a stock editor.

401.description: No valid token, or a token whose account has not been bootstrapped yet.

patch.summary: Change the caller name, phone, address or avatar
patch.description: Partial: a field that is absent is left alone, and `address`/`avatar_url` set to `null` are cleared. Role and active state are not editable here — they belong to an admin.

400.description: No field was supplied, an unknown field was sent, or a value is malformed.

get.description: Approved stalls only. `market_id` and `category` are "sells there / sells in" rather than joins, so a stall at four markets appears once. Ordered by rating, which is the only signal a shopper who has never seen the stall has.

400.description: `market_id` is not a uuid, or a page number is not positive.

get.summary: A stall profile: markets, this week, and recent reviews
get.description: Products carry this ISO week's quantity, and a listing with no stock row for the current week reads sold out rather than unlimited — a quantity nobody checked is not one you can order. Reviews are the ten most recent visible ones; the full history is not this screen's job.

404.description: No such stall, or one that is not approved — which is answered the same way.

get.summary: The caller's own stall, including its approval status
get.description: The awaiting-approval screen and the stock editor are the same payload read two ways: `status` here decides which one opens. Unlike the public profile, this shows a stall in any state, because it belongs to the person standing behind it.

403.description: The account is active but is not a farmer.

404.description: The account is a farmer but has no stall row.

patch.summary: Edit the stall: name, story, days, pickup window, cutoff
patch.description: Partial — an absent field is left alone and an explicit `null` clears it. `status` is not an editable field: approval is the admin queue's decision, and a farmer who could patch it would walk their own stall onto the public catalogue.

400.description: No field was supplied, a day name is not one of the seven, or the pickup window closes before it opens.

403.description: The account is not a farmer.

404.description: The account is a farmer but has no stall row.

post.summary: Move the stall pin from the map picker
post.description: Its own route rather than a field on the stall patch because it is a different gesture: a drag on a map, not a form submit. It should not have to resend a description the farmer never touched in order to shift a marker a hundred metres.

400.description: A coordinate is missing or off the map.

403.description: The account is not a farmer.

404.description: The account is a farmer but has no stall row.

get.summary: Which markets the caller’s stall attends
get.description: Each entry carries the pitch reference and the days this stall is there, which is what tells a farmer packing a van whether it is A12 on Tuesday or F01 on Saturday.

403.description: The account is not a farmer.

404.description: The account is a farmer but has no stall row.

get.description: Answers 200 only when `select 1` succeeds. Both statuses carry the same body, because a probe is read as a document rather than handled as an error.

200.description: The API and its database are both answering.

503.description: The API is up but cannot reach the database.

get.summary: List markets, for the discovery screen
get.description: Filters combine: `city` narrows by city, `day` to markets operating that weekday, `q` searches name, address and city, and `open_now` keeps only markets trading at this moment in Lagos. Ordered by name, so paging is stable.

400.description: A day is not one of the seven, or a page number is not positive.

get.summary: Markets within a radius of a point, nearest first
get.description: The map and the "nearby" rail. Distances are straight-line kilometres from the point given, not driving times: Lagos traffic is not something this can know, and a number that reads like an ETA invites a user to trust it as one. The query bounds a rectangle and measures inside it, so adding markets does not slow every nearby call down by a full scan.

schema.description: Decimal degrees. Strictly inside ±90 because the bounding-box maths for "nearby" divides by cos(lat), which is zero at the poles.

200.description: A page of markets, nearest first, each with its distance.

400.description: `lat` or `lng` is missing or unmap-able, or the radius is not usable.

get.summary: One market, its stall roster, and how much is on the tables
get.description: Roster entries carry the stall's own pitch reference and the days it attends, which can be narrower than the market's own week — a trader who only comes on Saturdays is listed under Saturdays. Pending and suspended stalls are absent rather than marked.

404.description: No such market, or one the admin has taken off the list.
